name: Evidence and data
summary: Stats, charts, 2x2s, status and image-led evidence.

templates.name: Key stats, four metrics
templates.purpose: Four headline numbers that prove one claim, with a single supporting sentence.

slide.title: Northfield closes in [[5 days]] and saves $4.2M a year

source.text: West Monroe analysis of the FY26 baseline; run-rate after wave 3.

body.text: Automated matching clears the intercompany balances that today take three people four days each month. Moving review to the point of posting means exceptions are fixed on day one instead of being found on day nine.
Together they remove about 11,000 hours of manual effort a year across the 14 business units, and let the controller sign off on day five without adding headcount.
